about: Mimic refuses what Scarlet and Violet's refuses and copies Double Iron Bash (Pokemon Central, Mimica; Showdown's gen-9 failmimic, which Double Iron Bash has not got). Before, Mimic's list was the engine's: it copied Celebrate and refused Double Iron Bash. A level-10 Pikachu is given Mimic and Splash in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Celebrate, then only Double Iron Bash. Mimic fails on the Celebrate and learns the Double Iron Bash. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
